itemListElement.name: Eye Doctor in Clear Lake, Houston TX

acceptedAnswer.text: We are at 515 Bay Area Blvd #300, Houston, TX 77058, in Clear Lake — the same address since 1984. Parking is directly in front and the entrance is straight ahead from the lot, with no stairs. You can open us in Google Maps or call (281) 488-0066 and we will talk you in.

Yes. We are open Saturdays from 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM, which is when a lot of the working and school-age appointments land. We are open Monday, Tuesday, Thursday and Friday from 9:30 AM to 6:30 PM, and closed Wednesdays and Sundays.

We accept most vision and medical plans, including VSP, EyeMed, Superior Vision, Aetna, Blue Cross Blue Shield, Medicare, Cigna and Tricare. CareCredit financing is available and cash is welcome. Call (281) 488-0066 and we will check your plan and your benefits before you come in, or read how billing works.

mainEntity.name: How much is an eye exam?

acceptedAnswer.text: Pricing is quote-based, because what you pay depends on your plan, your benefits and what the visit turns out to involve. We do not publish figures we cannot stand behind. Call us with your insurance details and the front desk can usually tell you in a minute.

mainEntity.name: How old should my child be for a first exam?

acceptedAnswer.text: We generally see children from about age four or five for a first full exam, earlier if you or your paediatrician have a specific concern. First contact lens fittings usually happen around ten to twelve. More on children’s eye care and pediatric eye exams.

We do not perform LASIK surgery here, but we handle the co-management around it — the evaluation beforehand and your follow-up care afterwards, with the surgery itself done by the surgeon. See LASIK co-management.

No. This is a private practice with one doctor, not a chain counter with a rota. Your eye doctor in Clear Lake is Dr. Jerry Hyder, OD, who has practiced here since 1984, you see him at every visit, and he has your history in front of him rather than reading it cold. More about the doctor.

mainEntity.name: How long does an appointment take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A comprehensive exam runs about 30 minutes with the doctor, and it is not compressed to fit more appointments into the day. Allow extra time if you are choosing frames afterwards, or if your eyes are being dilated.

mainEntity.name: Can I be seen the same day for an eye emergency?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Call (281) 488-0066 as early in the day as you can. Outside our hours the after-hours line is (281) 217-1281, and for an eye injury or a sudden change in your vision, go to your nearest emergency room.

mainEntity.name: Do I need an appointment to look at frames?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Walk-ins are welcome if you want to browse the frame wall or have a pair adjusted. An appointment is only needed for an exam or a contact lens fitting.
